WHAT WAS HARD TO FIND & OUR SCIENTIFIC, MATHEMATICAL & PROGRAMMATIC HYPOTHESES MARS 2000 · 4.74M SQUARES

What was hard to build & our three hypotheses

01 · ZERO MARS WALKERS

Only Moon walks (Apollo) & Mars rovers exist.

02 · RAW NASA ARCHIVES

Cleaned 10+ PDS/USGS datasets (HiRISE, CTX, MEDA).

03 · SPACE FORMATS

Mars 2000 sphere, Sols & GeoTIFFs on one 8 m grid.

04 · TRUSTED ALGORITHM

Explainable Dijkstra + hard locks over black-box AI.

1. SCIENTIFIC HYPOTHESIS

Moon Humans + Mars Rovers

Human step choices & O₂ work rates transfer from Apollo 11–17 moonwalks; Martian sand/scarp penalties transfer from Perseverance drives, bounded by an Apollo walkback reserve.

O₂ = 0.08 kg/h · (W / 285W)
2. MATHEMATICAL HYPOTHESIS

Conditional Logit + Weighted Product

Category weights w = e−β are learned from 1 chosen step vs. 15 alternatives, combined via a dimension-free Weighted Product while >15° slopes stay ∞-cost blocks.

cost(i) = tbase(θi) × ∏ Fg7·wg
3. PROGRAMMATIC HYPOTHESIS

Puzzle-Piece Architecture

Every data store & AI model fits a startup-verified contract (CostProviderI, PriorityResolverI), hot-swapping local math for HTTP ML models or live suit APIs with safe fallback.

registry.verify() → Local | HTTP ML

From terrain to route in five steps

1

Base cost

Walking time across each square, from its slope

2

Learned weights

Each category multiplies the cost: above 1 avoid, below 1 prefer

3

Route-type limits

Each route type caps how strong each weight group can be

4

Hard limits

Slopes over 15°, hazard cores and squares past the oxygen walkback are blocked

5

Dijkstra

Finds the lowest-cost path from start to destination

THE COST OF ONE SQUARE
cost = walking time × w1 × w2 × …

1

Train

Apollo moonwalks teach human choices; Perseverance and Curiosity drives teach shared terrain only.

2

Test

20% of real segments are kept aside; learned weights must rebuild them better than hand-set ones.

★

Guard

Hazards never come out preferred, hard limits are never learned, and a hand-set fallback is always ready.
